decisions.reason: The certified HVAC plate exchanger line is close to the core offer and has no reported shortfall, but it has been out of view since 2018 and has thin evidence of results, so it carries moderate risk and is kept for now under available slack.
The firm claims a major market share in water cooling systems, so results meet aspirations and nothing triggers problemistic search.
The marine cooling unit complements the successful box cooler line, and slack in a hiring, R&D-active firm allows it to be carried despite uncertain results.
The finned tube supports the core air cooler business and shows no performance gap, so withdrawing it would weaken an established offering.
The enhanced tubes embody the firm's in-house R&D and efficiency strategy, and with no shortfall against aspiration they remain worth carrying.
